doc.name: Ariberi — free freight exchange
doc.instructions: Ariberi is a free freight exchange (load board) for Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, China, Russia and the Caucasus. Loads are collected from logistics chats (Telegram, WhatsApp). Use search_loads to find active truck loads by route and body type, list_routes to see which routes have loads. City names may be given in Russian or English. Contacts of the shipper are not returned: give the user the load's url — the contact opens on ariberi.com after signing in with a phone number. Free, no commission.

tools.name: search_loads
tools.title: Search truck loads
tools.description: Search active freight loads (cargo looking for a truck) on Ariberi. Give from_city, to_city or both. Returns route, cargo, body type, weight, price if stated, road distance, loading date, posting time and a url of the load on ariberi.com (the shipper's phone opens there after sign-in). Newest first.

from_city.description: Loading city, e.g. Khorgos / Хоргос, Almaty, Alashankou

to_city.description: Unloading city, e.g. Tashkent / Ташкент, Moscow

body.description: Truck body type: tent (curtainsider), reefer, tandem (drawbar combination), flatbed, lowbed (low-loader), car carrier. Russian names also accepted.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.title: Routes with loads
tools.description: List routes that currently have active loads on Ariberi, busiest first, with the number of loads and a url of the route page. Optionally filter by from_city or to_city.
